That night he polished the lens longer than usual, knowing that somewhere out on the dark water, someone had once been watching.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒。路灯把空荡荡的街道照成昏黄色，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯划开薄雾，又很快消失。便利店的灯还亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处传来环卫工人扫地的沙沙声，一下一下，很有节奏。高楼的窗户大多漆黑，只有零星几盏灯还亮着，不知道是熬夜的人，还是早起的人。风有点凉，吹过天桥，带来早点铺第一笼包子的香气。天边开始泛出一点灰白，城市正在慢慢醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine a stack of boxes inside boxes: to find the toy, you open a box, and if there's another box inside, you do the same thing again.\n- You stop when you reach the smallest box with the toy, and that stopping point is called the base case."}
